rdfs:label: Photo
rdfs:comment: Deprecated. Intended as a vCard Photo class, but the W3C vCard ontology defines no Photo class — only the hasPhoto property.
notes: Deprecated: there is no `vcard:Photo` class in the W3C vCard ontology (http://www.w3.org/2006/vcard/ns), so this term has no upstream equivalent. Use `urn:solid:hasPhoto` with the image IRI as its value. For structured image metadata, describe the image as a `urn:solid:Image` (FOAF) or `urn:solid:ImageObject` (schema.org).
